desc: Derive the exact visibility condition using bottom and top slopes, including endpoint-touching cases.
Prove that all buildings are visible exactly when consecutive top slopes are strictly increasing.
Compute the maximum non-negative height at which visibility fails using pairwise thresholds.
Maintain the lower convex hull and query the minimum slope to previous buildings.
Handle the \(-1\) case, equality boundaries, \(N=1\), and floating-point output precision.
Implement and validate the integer-safe solution against all public samples.
